objective.text: Predict HEAD handling for a GET route and its response body.

difficulty.rationale: Separate route execution from the body sent for HEAD.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

files.source:
<?php

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;

Route::get('/ping', function () {
    return response('pong', 200);
});

stem: This is the only matching route. What status and body does a HEAD /ping request receive through the HTTP kernel?
